title: Normalized width of composed majority
statement: For every $\epsilon\in(0,1/2)$ and every natural number $m$, the normalized threshold width of the composed-majority family at index $m$ equals the threshold width of composed majority on $2+(2m+1)$ inputs, with both widths taken at $\epsilon$.
